findings.expected: Interactive OpenAPI explorer loads without CSP script errors and /api/v1/docs resolves cleanly.
findings.actual: https://unpkg.com/swagger-ui-dist@5/... was blocked by script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' and /api/v1/docs returned 404.
findings.cause: docs_api.go used external unpkg CDN scripts and main.go lacked /api/v1/docs aliases.
findings.fix: Replaced unpkg CDN with a self-contained CSP-compliant OpenAPI 3.0.3 explorer in docs_api.go and registered /api/v1/docs + /api/v1/openapi.json in main.go.

findings.reproduction: Call downloadAndDecryptWithPrivateKey() in sdk/crypto.ts using a server-generated BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY PEM.
findings.expected: WebCrypto imports the user's RSA key and unwraps the file DEK seamlessly.
findings.actual: handle_user_create.go generates PKCS#1 PEMs, which crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8', ...) rejects.
findings.cause: sdk/crypto.ts initially accepted only PKCS#8 private key DER buffers.
findings.fix: Added deterministic ASN.1 DER wrapPkcs1AsPkcs8 helper inside sdk/crypto.ts matching the React client.

findings.expected: Documentation accurately lists all 18 supported scopes and ABRN Drive URLs/key prefixes.
findings.actual: docs/agent-api.md referenced legacy QuantiX naming and omitted requests:create / requests:list.
findings.cause: Stale v1 documentation before v25-v30 rollout.
findings.fix: Synchronized docs/agent-api.md with ABRN Drive branding, abrnak_ / abrnak_del_ workflows, and all 18 scopes.
